fields.description: Fixes the bug where sidebar item filters include the operator in the URL value (e.g. workflow_state==,Awaiting MD Approval instead of workflow_state=Awaiting MD Approval). Disable this if the official Frappe release has resolved the issue.
fields.label: Enable Sidebar Item Filter Fix

fields.options:
About this fix: Affects frappe/public/js/frappe/ui/sidebar/sidebar_item.js — when a sidebar link has filters (e.g. Workflow State = Awaiting MD Approval), the standard code incorrectly passes the operator along with the value into the URL query string. This patch corrects that behaviour.

To verify the official fix: Disable the toggle above and test your sidebar links. If filters still work correctly, the upstream fix is in place and this patch is no longer needed.
